basic_details.job_title: IIEST Shibpur Junior Research Fellow (Chemistry) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Chemistry at Indian Institute of Engineering Science & Technology (IIEST), Shibpur has one Junior Research Fellow post in a PAIR Network project sponsored by ANRF, Govt. of India, with a fellowship of Rs. 37,000/- p.m. + Rs 11,100/- (30% HRA) = Rs 48,100/- per month. Candidates with an M.Sc. in Chemistry or allied branches and valid GATE/NET must email their application documents to [email protected] by 15 November 2026 at 5:00 pm and appear for the walk-in interview on 16 November 2026 at 11:30 AM.

how_to_apply: Prepare an application letter in plain paper, a recent bio-data, mark sheets and certificates.
Mention a valid e-mail id, residential address and phone number in the application for communication.
Email the soft copies to Dr. Papu Biswas, Associate Professor, Department of Chemistry, at [email protected].
Make sure the email is sent by 15 November 2026 at 5:00 pm.
Attend the walk-in interview on 16 November 2026 at 11:30 AM at the Office of the HoD, Department of Chemistry, IIEST, Shibpur.
The notice does not prescribe an email subject line or an application form format.
important_instructions: Soft copies of the application letter, bio-data, marksheets and certificates must be sent by e-mail in advance of the interview. All documents should be self-attested. Physical documents will be verified at the time of joining. Any discrepancy found in the documents at physical verification will lead to cancellation of the selection.

content_sections.heading: IIEST Shibpur Junior Research Fellow at a Glance
content_sections.text: The official notification does not mention an application fee.

rows.details: Indian Institute of Engineering Science & Technology (IIEST), Shibpur

PAIR Network Project titled "An Eight Institution Partnership for Advancing Materials Research and Development: From Fundamental Design to Emerging Applications in Structural, Functional and Biomaterials Spaces"
Duration of the Project: five years from the date of commencement or till the project continues, whichever is earlier
Department of Chemistry, IIEST, Shibpur, Howrah
Email (soft copies in advance), followed by walk-in interview

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential qualification: M. Sc. in Chemistry or allied branches from a recognized University/Institute with minimum 60% marks or 6.5 CGPA on a 10-point scale, with valid GATE/NET. Relaxation in marks: For SC/ST/PwD category candidates, a minimum of 55% marks or 6.0 CGPA on a 10-point scale is required, with valid GATE/NET. Age limit: Maximum 28 years. The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age. A valid GATE/NET score is part of the essential qualification for every category. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility wording of the post.

rows.age_relaxation: Upper age limit relaxable up to 5 years

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Junior Research Fellow receives a fellowship of Rs. 37,000/- p.m. plus Rs 11,100/- as HRA (30%), making Rs 48,100/- per month. The post is tied to the ANRF PAIR Network project, whose duration is five years from the date of commencement or till the project continues, whichever is earlier. The notice does not mention any other allowance.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIEST Shibpur Junior Research Fellow
content_sections.text: Prepare an application letter in plain paper, a recent bio-data, mark sheets and certificates. Self-attest all the documents. Mention a valid e-mail id, residential address and phone number in the application for communication. Email the soft copies to Dr. Papu Biswas, Associate Professor, Department of Chemistry, at [email protected] . Make sure the email is sent by 15 November 2026 at 5:00 pm. Attend the walk-in interview on 16 November 2026 at 11:30 AM at the Office of the HoD, Department of Chemistry, IIEST, Shibpur. The notice does not prescribe an email subject line or an application form format.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection is through a walk-in interview on 16 November 2026 at 11:30 AM at the Office of the HoD, Department of Chemistry, IIEST, Shibpur. Short listing may be done before the interview (if required), based on the soft copies emailed in advance. Physical documents will be verified at the time of joining, and the selection will be canceled if any discrepancies are found in the documents at the time of physical verification.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IIEST Shibpur JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is one (01) Junior Research Fellow post in the Department of Chemistry under Advt. No. CH 1696.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIEST Shibpur JRF post?
faq.answer: Soft copies of the application must be emailed by 15 November 2026 at 5:00 pm, and the walk-in interview is on 16 November 2026 at 11:30 AM.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the IIEST Shibpur Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: An M. Sc. in Chemistry or allied branches from a recognized University/Institute with minimum 60% marks or 6.5 CGPA on a 10-point scale, along with valid GATE/NET.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the IIEST Shibpur JRF post?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 28 years, relaxable up to 5 years for SC/ST/OBC/Woman and Physically handicapped candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the fellowship for the IIEST Shibpur JRF?
faq.answer: The fellowship is Rs. 37,000/- p.m. + Rs 11,100/- (30% HRA) = Rs 48,100/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA included in the IIEST Shibpur JRF pay?
faq.answer: Yes, Rs 11,100/- is added as 30% HRA on the Rs. 37,000/- fellowship, giving Rs 48,100/- per month.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the IIEST Shibpur JRF post?
faq.answer: Email self-attested soft copies of the application letter, bio-data, mark sheets and certificates to [email protected] by 15 November 2026, 5:00 pm, then attend the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the IIEST Shibpur JRF?
faq.answer: Selection is by walk-in interview at the Office of the HoD, Department of Chemistry, IIEST, Shibpur on 16 November 2026 at 11:30 AM; short listing may be done before the interview if required.

faq.question: Q9. Who gets a relaxation in marks and age for the IIEST Shibpur JRF?
faq.answer: SC/ST/PwD candidates need a minimum of 55% marks or 6.0 CGPA instead of 60% or 6.5 CGPA, and SC/ST/OBC/Woman and Physically handicapped candidates get up to 5 years' relaxation in the upper age limit.

faq.question: Q10. How long is the IIEST Shibpur JRF project?
faq.answer: The duration of the project is five years from the date of commencement or till the project continues, whichever is earlier.
